the delight of the wisdom of Guru (gurmat) was attained and the sufferings of evil mindedness got burnt and wiped out."}}},{"verse_id":204341,"page_no":24,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਮਹਣਾ।","translit_en":"acharaj no acharaj milai visamaadhai visamaadh samahanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wonder met the wonder and becoming wondrous got imbued with the wonder (Guru Nanak)."}}},{"verse_id":204342,"page_no":24,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਣ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣੁ ਅਸਹੀਅਣੁ ਸਹਣਾ।","translit_en":"apiau peean nijhar jharan ajar jaran asaheean sahanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"After quaffing the nectar the fountain of joy emerges to flew and then the power of bearing the unbearable is obtained"}}},{"verse_id":204343,"page_no":24,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਹਣਾ।","translit_en":"sach samaanaa sach vich gaaddee raahu saadhasa(n)g vahanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Moving on the highway of the holy congregation, the truth has merged into the truth."}}},{"verse_id":204344,"page_no":24,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਬਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"baabaanai ghar chaanan lahanaa ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In fact Lahana became the light of Baba Nanak's house."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40531,"next":40533}}

Neither he dies nor he suffers the pangs of the separation from the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":204425,"page_no":24,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਇ ਪਿਤ ਕਫੁ ਰੋਗ ਅਰੋਗੀ।","translit_en":"aadh biaadh upaadh hai vai pit kaf rog arogee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is not troubled by pains and maladies and he remains free from the diseases of air, cough and heat."}}},{"verse_id":204426,"page_no":24,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਅਪਦਾ ਸੋਗੀ।","translit_en":"dhukh sukh samasar gurmatee sa(n)pai harakh na apadhaa sogee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He accepts sufferings and joys alike; wisdom of the Guru is his wealth and he is uninfluenced by joy and sorrows."}}},{"verse_id":204427,"page_no":24,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹੀ ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"dheh bidhehee log alogee ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being embodied he is yet beyond the body and while living in the world he is beyond the world."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40541,"next":40543}}

wisdom and praise."}}},{"verse_id":204464,"page_no":24,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਸੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"gur govi(n)dh govi(n)dh gur harigovi(n)dh sadhaa vigasa(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Accepting Guru,(Arjan Dev) as God and God as Guru, Hargobind (the Guru)remains ever elated."}}},{"verse_id":204465,"page_no":24,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"acharaj no acharaj milai visamaadhai visamaadh mila(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being full of wonder he is absorbed in the supreme :Wonder and thus being awe inspired he remains immersed in supreme rapture , rapture."}}},{"verse_id":204466,"page_no":24,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਕਾਰ ਨਿਬਹੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag chalanaa kha(n)dde dhaar kaar nibaha(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Moving on the way of gurmukhs is like treading on the edge of  sword."}}},{"verse_id":204467,"page_no":24,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਚਲੰਦਾ ॥੨੧॥","translit_en":"gur sikh lai gursikh chala(n)dhaa ||21||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Accepting the teachings of the Guru, the disciple adopts  them in his life."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40546,"next":40548}}

ਜਾਣੋਈ।","translit_en":"dhiaan mool gur dharasano pooran braham jaan jaanoiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glimpse of the Guru is the basis of meditation because Guru is Brahm and this fact is one."}}},{"verse_id":204711,"page_no":26,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਈ।","translit_en":"mokh mool kirapaal gur jeevan mukat saadhasa(n)g soiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The basis of liberation is the grace of the Guru and one attains liberation in life in the holy congregation alone."}}},{"verse_id":204712,"page_no":26,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਰਲੋਈ।","translit_en":"aap ganai na paieeaai aap gavai milai viraloiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Making oneself noticed none can attain the Lord and even shedding the ego any rare one meets Him."}}},{"verse_id":204713,"page_no":26,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ।","translit_en":"aap gavaae aap hai sabh ko aap aape sabh koiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who annihilates his ego, in fact, is the Lord Himself; he knowns everyone as his form and all accept him as their form."}}},{"verse_id":204714,"page_no":26,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"gur chelaa chelaa gur hoiee ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This way that individual in the form of Guru becomes disciple and the disciple is turned to be Guru."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40576,"next":40578}}

here only he reaps who sows."}}},{"verse_id":204719,"page_no":26,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਫਲੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਫਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਤਕਾਲਾ।","translit_en":"falai kamaanaa tih jugee kalijug safal dharam tatakaalaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In other three yugs, the fruit of the action was earned and accumulated but in kaliyug, one gets the fruit of dharma immediately."}}},{"verse_id":204720,"page_no":26,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਵਾਲਾ।","translit_en":"paap kamaanai lep hai chitavai dharam sufal falavaalaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Somethin* happens only after doing something in the kaliyug but even the thought of dharma gives the happy fruit in it."}}},{"verse_id":204721,"page_no":26,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।","translit_en":"bhai bhagat gurapurab kar beejan beej sachee dharamasaalaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gurmukhs, contemplating on the wisdom of Guru and the loving devotion, sow the seed in earth, the true abode of truth."}}},{"verse_id":204722,"page_no":26,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਣ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"safal manorath pooran ghaalaa ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They succeed in their practice and objective."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40577,"next":40579}}

vogue."}}},{"verse_id":204725,"page_no":26,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਭਵਜਲ ਭਰਨਾਲਾ।","translit_en":"kalijug gurmukh naau lai paar pavai bhavajal bharanaalaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gurmukhs, in kaliyug go across the world-ocean by repeating the name of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":204726,"page_no":26,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਰਿ ਚਰਣ foot of dharma was made cripple."}}},{"verse_id":204727,"page_no":26,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਇ ਇਕਤੈ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੰਮੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ।","translit_en":"dhuaapur hoe pair dhui ikatai pair dhara(n)m dhukhaalaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In dvapar only two feet of dharma survived and in kaliyug the dharma stands only on one foot to undergo the sufferings."}}},{"verse_id":204728,"page_no":26,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ਜਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ।","translit_en":"maan nimaanai jaan kai binau karai kar nadhar nihaalaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Considering the Lord as the strength of the powerless ones, it (dharma) started praying for the liberation through the grace of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":204729,"page_no":26,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।","translit_en":"gur poorai paragaas kar dheeraj dharam sachee dharamasaalaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord manifesting in the form of the perfect Gum created the true abode of fortitude and the dharma."}}},{"verse_id":204730,"page_no":26,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਖੇਤ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"aape khet aape rakhavaalaa ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Himself is the field (of creation) and Himself its protector."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40578,"next":40580}}

devotees."}}},{"verse_id":205207,"page_no":28,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ।","translit_en":"gun keete gun kare jag avagun keete gun gur (ultimately)."}}},{"verse_id":205216,"page_no":28,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਹੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੧੨॥","translit_en":"aapahu kisai na jaanai ma(n)dhaa ||12||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Inverse is files.shabads/81/40643.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40643,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":28,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":205226,"last_verse_id":205233,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":205226,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"੧੪ : ਸਿਖ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰੀ ਤੇ ਪਰੋਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ","translit_en":"14 : sikh ni(n)mree te paropakaaree hai","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sikh, the humble and the benevolent    "}}},{"verse_id":205227,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਸੈ।","translit_en":"paanee a(n)dhar dharat hai dharatee a(n)dhar paanee vasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Earth is in water and in the earth also is water."}}},{"verse_id":205228,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਧਰਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਰਸੈ।","translit_en":"dharatee ra(n)g na ra(n)g sabh dharatee saau na sabh ras rasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Earth has no colour yet it has all colours (in the form of different vegetation) in it."}}},{"verse_id":205229,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਧਰਤੀ ਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਗੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਤਰਸੈ।","translit_en":"dharatee ga(n)dh na ga(n)dh bahu dharat na roop anoop tarasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Earth has no taste yet all the tastes are contained in it."}}},{"verse_id":205230,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਦਸੈ।","translit_en":"jehaa beejai so lunai karam bhoom sabh koiee dhasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No smell is there in the earth, yet all the fragrances reside in it."}}},{"verse_id":205231,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਕਸੂਤੁ ਨ ਧਸੈ।","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan lep na lep hai kar mal moot kasoot na dhasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Earth is a field for actions; here one reaps what one sows."}}},{"verse_id":205232,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਵੁਠੇ ਮੀਹ ਜਮਾਇਦੇ ਡਵਿ ਲਗੈ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ।","translit_en":"vuThe meeh jamaidhe ddav lagai a(n)goor vigasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Plastered with sandal paste, it does not get attached to it and fouled up by creatures' excreta it does not sink with anger and shame."}}},{"verse_id":205233,"page_no":28,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਖਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਹਸੈ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"dhukh na rovai sukh na hasai ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"After rains people sow corn in it and even after (getting heat) fire new seedlings sprout from it. files.shabads/81/40660.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40660,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":29,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":205363,"last_verse_id":205370,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":205363,"page_no":29,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"੯ : ਮਨਵਸ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ-ਅੱਠ ਗਿਣਤੀ","translit_en":"9 : manavas saadh sa(n)ga-a'Th ginatee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Association with the saints  the count of eight,  - "}}},{"verse_id":205364,"page_no":29,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਅਠਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਧਿਆਇਆ।","translit_en":"aThakha(n)dd paakha(n)dd mat gurmat ik man ik dhiaaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The person conducting in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru, goes beyond the hypocrisies of eight division (of four varnas and four ashramas) and adores the Lord with single minded devotion."}}},{"verse_id":205365,"page_no":29,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਿਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"asaTadhaat paaras milee gurmukh ka(n)chan jot jagaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eight metals in the form of four vamas and four religions having met the philosopher's stone in the form of Guru have convereted themselves into gold, the gurmukh, the enlightened one."}}},{"verse_id":205366,"page_no":29,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾਂ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"ridh sidh sidh saadhikaa(n) aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The siddhs and other miraculous practitioners have saluted to that primal Lord alone."}}},{"verse_id":205367,"page_no":29,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"aThe pahar araadheeaai sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That Lord ought to be adored all the eight watches of time; At the smell of the former the nose is turned away whereas the latter's fragrance is pleasing to mind."}}},{"verse_id":205513,"page_no":30,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਕ ਅੰਬ ਫਲ ਕਉੜਾ ਮਿਠਾ ਸਾਉ ਲਹੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"kooR sach ak a(n)b fal kauRaa miThaa saau laha(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Falsehood and truth are like akk, the wild plant of sandy region and mango tree which bear bitter and sweet fruits respectively."}}},{"verse_id":205514,"page_no":30,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਹ ਚੋਰ ਸਚ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਵੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭਵੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"saeh chor sach kooR hai saahu savai chor firai bhava(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Truth and falsehood are like the bankar and the thief; the banker sleeps comfortably whereas the thief roams about hither and thither."}}},{"verse_id":205515,"page_no":30,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਹ ਫੜੈ ਉਠਿ ਚੋਰ ਨੋ ਤਿਸ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਦੀਬਾਣ ਕਰੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"saeh faRai uTh chor no tis nukasaan dheebaan kara(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The banker catches hold of the thief and gets him further punished in the courts."}}},{"verse_id":205516,"page_no":30,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜੈ ਲੈ ਨਿਹਣਿ ਬਹੰਦਾ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"sach kooRai lai nihan baha(n)dhaa ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The truth ultimately puts shackles around the falsehood."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40677,"next":40679}}

but if shellac attacks the tree, the latter is destroyed (similarly falsehood decimates the individual)."}}},{"verse_id":205537,"page_no":30,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਸਉ ਵਰਿਆ ਅਗਿ ਰੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਸਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਗਿ ਬਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੁਖੈ।","translit_en":"sau variaa ag rukh vich bhasam karai ag bi(n)dhak dhukhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For hundreds of years, the fire remains latent in the tree, but enraged by a small spark, it destroys the ree (similarly the falsehood ever remaining in the mind, ultimately destroys the man)."}}},{"verse_id":205538,"page_no":30,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੈਦ ਵੇਦਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੈ।","translit_en":"sach dhaaroo kooR rog hai vin gur vaidh vedhan manmukhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The truth is medicine whereas the falsehood is a disease which inflicts the manmukhs who are without physician in the form of Guru."}}},{"verse_id":205539,"page_no":30,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੁ ਸਥੋਈ ਕੂੜ ਠਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੈ।","translit_en":"sach sathoiee kooR Thag lagai dhukh na gurmukh sukhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Truth is companion and the falsehood a cheat who cannot make the gurmukh suffer (because they ever abide in the pleasure of truth)."}}},{"verse_id":205540,"page_no":30,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂੜੁ ਪਚੈ ਸਚੈ ਦੀ ਭੁਖੈ ॥੯॥","translit_en":"kooR pachai sachai dhee bhukhai ||9||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Falsehood perishes and the truth is ever desired."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40680,"next":40682}}

॥੧੦॥","translit_en":"sach sachaa kooR kooR vikhoaa ||10||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The adopter of truth is ever known as truthful and the follower of falsehood is ever considered a dhehaaRee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kite cannot be taught texts and eating rats keeps on flying the whole day."}}},{"verse_id":205820,"page_no":32,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਂਸ ਨੋ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਦਣ ਵਾੜੀ।","translit_en":"vaas na aavai vaa(n)s no haumai ag na cha(n)dhan vaaRee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even being in the garden of sandal wood, the egotist bamboo does not get body."}}},{"verse_id":205822,"page_no":32,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਪ ਗਣਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਅਨਾੜੀ।","translit_en":"si(n)mal birakh na safal hoi aap ganaae vaddaa answer."}}},{"verse_id":205828,"page_no":32,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਫੁਲਵਾੜੀ ਵੜਿ ਗੁਣਗੁਣਾ ਮਾਲੀ ਨੋ ਨ ਇਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"fulavaaRee vaR gunagunaa maalee no na inaam award."}}},{"verse_id":205829,"page_no":32,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਲੂਲੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਆਹੀਐ ਕਿਵ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"loole naal viaaheeaai kiv gal mil kaaman gal laavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How could a woman married to a cripple embrace him."}}},{"verse_id":205830,"page_no":32,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭਨਾ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਲੰਗੜਾ ਕਰੇ ਲਖਾਉ ਲੰਗਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"sabhanaa chaal suhaavanee la(n)gaRaa kare lakhaau la(n)gaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where all others have a fair gait, the lame however he may pretend, would definitely be seen limping."}}},{"verse_id":205831,"page_no":32,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਲੁਕੈ ਨ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"lukai na moorakh aap lakhaavai ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus, the fool never remains hidden, and he definitely exposes himself."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40716,"next":40718}}

varasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It may rain for four months continuously, but a stone would not sprout in the field."}}},{"verse_id":205835,"page_no":32,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਪਥਰਿ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਰਗੜੀਏ ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਂਗਿ ਨ ਪਥਰੁ ਘਸੈ।","translit_en":"pathar cha(n)nan ragaRe'e cha(n)nan vaa(n)g na pathar ghasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A stone grinding sandal, never gets worn off like rasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Grinding stones always grind the material but never know about the taste and virtues of the things ground."}}},{"verse_id":205837,"page_no":32,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਚਕੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਹੰਸਵਾਰ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਪੀਐ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਤਸੈ।","translit_en":"chakee firai saha(n)savaar khai na peeaai bhukh na tasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The grinding stone moves around thousands of times but it never feels hunger or thirst."}}},{"verse_id":205838,"page_no":32,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਪਥਰ ਘੜੈ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਉਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਘੜਾ ਵਿਣਸੈ।","translit_en":"pathar ghaRai varatanaa heTh ute hoi ghaRaa vinasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The relationship between the stone and the pitcher is such that pitcher has to perish whether the stone strikes the pitcher or vice versa."}}},{"verse_id":205839,"page_no":32,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਮੂਰਖ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਸ ਅਪਜਸੈ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"moorakh surat na jas apajasai ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The stupid does not understand the difference between fame and infamy."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40717,"next":40719}}

he remains adamant in any company       "}}},{"verse_id":205841,"page_no":32,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਪਥਰ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਨ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ।","translit_en":"paaras pathar sa(n)g hai paaras paras na ka(n)chan hovai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ordinary stone may be in contact with the philosopher's stone but it does not get transformed into gold."}}},{"verse_id":205842,"page_no":32,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਹੀਰੇ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਥਰਹੁ ਪਥਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ।","translit_en":"heere maanak patharahu pathar koi na haar parovai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Diamonds and rubies are extracted from the stones but the latter cannot be stringed as a necklace."}}},{"verse_id":205843,"page_no":32,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਵਟਿ ਜਵਾਹਰੁ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਵਿਕਾਇ ਸਮੋਵੈ।","translit_en":"vaT javaahar toleeaai mul na tul vikai samovai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The jewels are weighed with weights but the latter cannot equate in value with the jewels."}}},{"verse_id":205844,"page_no":32,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਥਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਸੁਵੰਨ ਅਲੋਵੈ।","translit_en":"pathar a(n)dhar asaTadhaat paaras paras suva(n)n alovai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eight metals (alloys) remain amidst stones but they convert into gold by the touch of philosopher's stone alone."}}},{"verse_id":205845,"page_no":32,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਥਰੁ ਫਟਕ ਝਲਕਣਾ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਗੋਵੈ।","translit_en":"pathar faTak jhalakanaa bahu ra(n)gee hoi ra(n)g na govai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Crystal stone shines in many colours but still remains a mere stone."}}},{"verse_id":205846,"page_no":32,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਥਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਸਾਉ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਕਠੋਰ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।","translit_en":"pathar vaas na saau hai man kaThor hoi aap vigovai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Stone has neither fragrance nor taste; the hard-hearted one simply destroys itself."}}},{"verse_id":205847,"page_no":32,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖਾਈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"kar moorakhaiee moorakh rovai ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The foolish goes on lamenting his own stupidity."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40718,"next":40720}}

"}}},{"verse_id":205849,"page_no":32,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉਂ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਵਿਸੂ ਭਰਿਆ।","translit_en":"jiau(n) man kaale sap sir saar na jaanai visoo tariaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Living in water the crane never learns how to swim and the stone, in spite of its ablutions at various pilgrimage centres cannot swim and go across."}}},{"verse_id":205854,"page_no":32,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਲਿ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਭਲੀ ਭਿਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਰਾਜਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਸਰਿਆ।","translit_en":"naal siaane bhalee bhikh moorakh raajahu kaaj na sariaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That is why, begging in the company of wise people is better then ruling over a kingdom alongwith Hoots."}}},{"verse_id":205855,"page_no":32,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਮੇਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗਾੜੈ ਖਰਿਆ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"mekhee hoi vigaaRai khariaa ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because he who himself is fake, will also spoil the pure one."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40719,"next":40721}}

samaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A wicked son can neither be repudiated nor he can adjust in the family."}}},{"verse_id":205862,"page_no":32,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਮੂਰਖ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਵੈਰੁ ||9||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Otherwise, both the ways, suffering is bound to occur."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40720,"next":40722}}

files.shabads/81/40730.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40730,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":32,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":205926,"last_verse_id":205933,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":205926,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"੧੮ : ਪੰਡਤ ਵੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ","translit_en":"18 : pa(n)ddat vee moorakh ho sakadhaa hai","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even a pandit could be a fool     "}}},{"verse_id":205927,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਾਂਗੇ ਤੇਲੀਐ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖੈ।","translit_en":"gosaT gaa(n)ge teleeaai pa(n)ddit naal hovai jag dhekhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A discussion between Gangu, the oilman and a pandit was being witnessed by one and all."}}},{"verse_id":205928,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਖੜੀ ਕਰੈ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੁਲੀ ਗਾਂਗਾ ਦੁਇ ਵੇਖਾਲੈ ਰੇਖੈ।","translit_en":"khaRee karai ik a(n)gulee gaa(n)gaa dhui vekhaalai rekhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Showing one finger to Gang/ the pandit indicated that the Lord is one. But Gangu thought that he wanted to extract his (Ganges) one eye and hence he showed two fingers indicating that he will bring out both of his (pandit's) eyes."}}},{"verse_id":205929,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਫੇਰਿ ਉਚਾਇ ਪੰਜਾਂਗੁਲਾ ਗਾਂਗਾ ਮੁਠਿ ਹਲਾਇ ਅਲੇਖੈ।","translit_en":"fer uchai pa(n)jaa(n)gulaa gaa(n)gaa muTh halai alekhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But the pandit thought that Gangu is hinting at the two dimensions of Lord - nirgun (beyond all virtues) and sagun, (with all virtues)."}}},{"verse_id":205930,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਭੇਖੈ।","translit_en":"pairee pai uTh chaliaa pa(n)ddit haar bhulaavai bhekhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pandit now raised five fingers to show that His two forms are due to the five elements, but, considering the pandit as indicating that with five fingers he would scratch the face of Gangu,"}}},{"verse_id":205931,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਅੰਗ ਦੁਇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਸਰੇਖੈ।","translit_en":"niragun saragun a(n)g dhui paramesar pa(n)j milan sarekhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gangs brandished his fist showing that he would kill him by the stroke of his fist. Now pandit felt that he was being made to understand that unity of five elements was the cause of the creation."}}},{"verse_id":205932,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਅਖੀ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਭੰਨਸਾਂ ਮੁਕੀ ਲਾਇ ਹਲਾਇ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ।","translit_en":"akhee dhove(n) bha(n)nasaa(n) mukee lai halai nimekhai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Mistakingly the pandit accepted his defeat and fell at his opponent's feet and left the place. In fact the fool had meant that he would bring out his eyes and attack with a tight fist but this was interpreted differently by the pandit."}}},{"verse_id":205933,"page_no":32,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"moorakh pa(n)ddit surat visekhai ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus because of his specific thinking even the pandit was also proved a fool."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40729,"next":40731}}
files.shabads/81/40731.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40731,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":32,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":205934,"last_verse_id":205941,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":205934,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"੧੯ : ਮੂਰਖ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤ ਦਾ ਫਲ","translit_en":"19 : moorakh dhee sa(n)gat dhaa fal","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The result of association with the stupid one    "}}},{"verse_id":205935,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਠੰਢੇ ਖੂਹਹੁੰ ਨ੍ਹਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਗ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੈ।","translit_en":"Tha(n)dde khoohahu(n) nhai kai pag visaar aaiaa sir na(n)gai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having taken bath on the well, a person forgot his turban and returned home bare headed."}}},{"verse_id":205936,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਨਾ ਕਮਲੀਆਂ ਧੁਸੀ ਲੀਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਢੰਗੈ।","translit_en":"ghar vich ra(n)naa kamaleeaa(n) dhusee leetee dhekh kudda(n)gai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing his improper conduct (of being bare headed) the silly women started weeping and wailing (Seeing turbanless master of the house they conjectured the death of some one in the family)."}}},{"verse_id":205937,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਰੰਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਟੰਦੀਆ ਢਾਹਾਂ ਮਾਰੈਂ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਗੈ।","translit_en":"ra(n)naa dhekh piTa(n)dheeaa ddaahaa(n) maarai(n) hoi nisa(n)gai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing the weeping women, others too, began mourning. People gethered and sitting in lines started condoling with the family."}}},{"verse_id":205938,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਕ ਸਿਆਪੇ ਆਇਆ ਰੰਨਾ ਪੁਰਸ ਜੁੜੇ ਲੈ ਪੰਗੈ।","translit_en":"lok siaape aaiaa ra(n)naa puras juRe lai pa(n)gai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now the barber woman who leads the mourning on occasions asked as to who is to be wept and whose dirge she should lead, i.e. what is the name of the dead."}}},{"verse_id":205939,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਇਣ ਪੁਛਦੀ ਪਿਟਦੀਆਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ਅਲ੍ਹਾਣੀ ਅੰਗੈ।","translit_en":"nain puchhadhee piTadheeaa(n) kis dhai nai alhaanee a(n)gai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The daughter-in-law of family hinted towards father-in-law to elicit answer of this question (because he was found bare headed."}}},{"verse_id":205940,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹੁਰੇ ਪੁਛਹ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਉਣ ਮੁਆ ਨੂਹ ਉਤਰੁ ਮੰਗੈ।","translit_en":"sahure puchheh jai kai kaun muaa nooh utar ma(n)gai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then the fact was disclosed by him that he just forgot to wear turban)."}}},{"verse_id":205941,"page_no":32,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਵਾਂ ਰੌਲਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸੰਗੈ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"kaavaa(n) raualaa moorakh sa(n)gai ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the assembly of the fools such cawing takes place (because crows also listening to one voice start cawing jointly)."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40730,"next":40732}}

sung."}}},{"verse_id":207044,"page_no":39,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨਸਿਮਰਨ ਸਦਾ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਸਬਦਬਿਚਾਰਾ।","translit_en":"giaan dhiaanasimaran sadhaa bhaau bhagat bhau there."}}},{"verse_id":207045,"page_no":39,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਨਸਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਰਤਨ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ।","translit_en":"naam dhaan inasaan dhiraR gurmukh pa(n)th ratan there."}}},{"verse_id":207046,"page_no":39,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਚਖੰਡਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ।","translit_en":"paraupakaaree satiguroo sachakha(n)dd vaasaa nira(n)kaaraa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The true Guru is benevolent and in his abode of truth, the formless Lord resides."}}},{"verse_id":207047,"page_no":39,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧਿਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ।","translit_en":"chaudheh vidhiaa sodhikai gurmukh sukh fal sach piaaraa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Practising all the fourteen skills, the gurmukhs have identified upar gurmukh sach aachaaraa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Everything is below truth but, for the gurmukhs truthful conduct is higher than the truth."}}},{"verse_id":207049,"page_no":39,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਤਰੈ ਸੈਂਸਾਰਾ।","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat gur upadhes tarai sai(n)saaraa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the fragrance of sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant, the whole world gets across through the teachings of the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":207050,"page_no":39,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੁਸੀਆਰਾ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"apiau peea gurmat huseeaaraa ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Drinking the nectar of the Guru's teaching, the Jiv becomes awake and alert."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40875,"next":40877}}

"}}},{"verse_id":207052,"page_no":39,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਅਮਲੀ ਸੋਫੀ ਚਾਕਰਾਂ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬੰਨੇ।","translit_en":"amalee sofee chaakaraa(n) aap aapane laage ba(n)ne|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Servants, addict as well as teetotaller, may be in the vicinity, but the minister"}}},{"verse_id":207053,"page_no":39,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹਰਮ ਹੋਹਿ ਵਜੀਰ ਸੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਮੂਲ ਨ ਮੰਨੇ।","translit_en":"maharam hoh vajeer so ma(n)tr piaalaa mool na ma(n)ne|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who knows ins and outs of the court never accepts their Guru."}}},{"verse_id":207056,"page_no":39,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਅਮਲੀ ਸੂਫੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕੰਨੇ।","translit_en":"gurmat alakh na lakheeaai amalee soofee lagai na ones)."}}},{"verse_id":207057,"page_no":39,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਅਮਲੀ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਅਮਲੀਆਂ ਸੋਫੀ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਫੀ ਵੰਨੇ।","translit_en":"amalee jaanan amaleeaa(n) sofee jaanan sofee va(n)ne|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The addicts are acquainted with addicts, likewise, teetotallers meet the teetotallers."}}},{"verse_id":207058,"page_no":39,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਹੇਤੁ ਵਜੀਰੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਦੁਇ ਖੋੜੀ ਇਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਿਧੰਨੇ।","translit_en":"het vajeerai paatisaeh dhui khoRee ik jeeau sidha(n)ne|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The affection between a king and his minister is such as if the rahan dhui kha(n)ne|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This relationship is also like the relation of the sword in the sheath; the two may be separate, yet they are one ( i.e. sword in sheath is yet called sword only)."}}},{"verse_id":207060,"page_no":39,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਜਿਵੈਂ ਰਸ ਗੰਨੇ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"veeh ikeeh jivai(n) ras ga(n)ne ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Likewise is the relation of gurmukhs with the Guru; they are subsumed in each other in such a manner as is the juice and the sugarcane."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40876,"next":40878}}

ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਦੀ ਚਉਕੀ ਆਏ।","translit_en":"chaakar amalee sofeeaa(n) paatisaeh dhee chaukee aae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Servants, addict (of the Lord's name) as well as teetotallers devoid of Mitn came ਮਜਲਸ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾਏ।","translit_en":"laik dhe veechaar kai virale majalas vich sadhaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The intelligent king (God) selected a few to be his parachaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He, a clever person, made both the clever and the indifferent happy and put them to work."}}},{"verse_id":207066,"page_no":39,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਨਿ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਅਮਲੀਆਂ ਸੋਫੀ ਸਭ ਪਿਆਵਣ ਲਾਏ।","translit_en":"dhen piaale amaleeaa(n) sofee sabh piaavan laae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now, the so called teetotallers (religious persons) were engaged to serve drinks (nam) to the addicts."}}},{"verse_id":207067,"page_no":39,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਅਮਲੀ ਹੁਏ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਚੜ੍ਹੇ ਸਹਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਏ।","translit_en":"matavaale amalee hue pee pee chaRhe sahij ghar jaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The latter became exhilerated in the name of the Lord and attained tranquility"}}},{"verse_id":207068,"page_no":39,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਫੀ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਟਕਰਾਂ ਪੂਜ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਸੀਸ ਨਿਵਾਏ।","translit_en":"soofee maaran Takaraa(n) pooj nivaaje sees nivaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But the so-called religious persons (teetotallers who served mans to others) remained involved in the so-called prayer and ritualistic worship."}}},{"verse_id":207069,"page_no":39,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਜਾਬ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁਦੀ ਬਹਸ ਬਹਸਾਏ।","translit_en":"vedh kateb ajaab vich kar kar khudhee bahas bahasaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They under the tyranny of their religious books, the Vedas and the Katebas, kept busy in arrogant debates and discussions."}}},{"verse_id":207070,"page_no":39,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal viralaa paae ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ny rare gurmukh attains the fruit of the delight (of quaffing the drink of Lord's name)."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40877,"next":40879}}

ਰਸੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਗੵਾਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਣਾ ਤੇ ਗੵਾਨੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਨਾਂਹ","translit_en":"9 : raseeaa(n) ne gayeaaneeaa(n) noo(n) dhenaa te gayeaaneeaa(n) dhee naa(n)h","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The devout offer joy to the vain court."}}},{"verse_id":207073,"page_no":39,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਉਕੀ ਮਹਲ ਦੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਵੈ।","translit_en":"a(n)dhar chaukee mahal dhee baahar maradhaanaa mil ਮਹਲਿ ਪਿਲਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"peeaai piaalaa paatisaahu a(n)dhar khaasaa(n) mahal pilaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Emperor (Lord) Himself quaffes the cup (of love) and arranges to serve the select ones inside."}}},{"verse_id":207075,"page_no":39,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਵਨ ਅਮਲੀ ਸੂਫ਼ੀਆਂ ਅਵਲ ਦੋਮ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"dhevan amalee soopheeaa(n) aval dhom dhekh dhikhalaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Keeping in view the two categories of the likely addicts and the teetotallers (so-called religious persons) He Himself distributes the wine of love to them."}}},{"verse_id":207076,"page_no":39,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰੇ ਮਨਾਹ ਸਰਾਬ ਦੀ ਪੀਐ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"kare manaeh saraab dhee peeaai aap na hor sukhaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The teetotaller (engaged in ritualism) neither drinks the wine of love himself nor allows others to drink."}}},{"verse_id":207077,"page_no":39,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਉਲਸ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"aulas piaalaa mihar kar virale dhei na pachhotaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Getting pleased, that Lord goes on giving the cup of His grace to the rare ones and never regrets."}}},{"verse_id":207078,"page_no":39,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਵੈ ਕਿਹੈ ਦਾ ਗੁਨਹ ਕਰਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬਖਸਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"kih na vasaavai kihai dhaa guneh karai hukam bakhasaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"None is to blame, lie himself makes the creatures commit crime and himself pardons their sins in the hukam, the divine will."}}},{"verse_id":207079,"page_no":39,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੈ ਜਣਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"hor naa jaanai piram ras jaanai aap kai jisai janaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"None else understands the mystery of the delight of His love; only He himself knows or the one whom He makes to know."}}},{"verse_id":207080,"page_no":39,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਵਿਰਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥੯॥","translit_en":"virale gurmukh alakh lakhaavai ||9||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Any rare gurmukh beholds files.shabads/81/40880.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40880,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":39,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":10,"first_verse_id":207081,"last_verse_id":207090,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":207081,"page_no":39,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"੧੦ : ਬੇਅਮਲੀਆਂ ਗੵਾਨੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਹਾਲ","translit_en":"10 : beamaleeaa(n) gayeaaneeaa(n) dhaa haal","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The condition of the non-addicts or hollow scholars   "}}},{"verse_id":207082,"page_no":39,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ਸੂਫੀ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾ।","translit_en":"vedh kateb vakhaanadhe soofee hi(n)dhoo musalamaanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Devoid of the love (of the Lord) Hindu and Muslim scholars describe the Vedas and the Katebas respectively."}}},{"verse_id":207083,"page_no":39,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਭਾਣਾ।","translit_en":"musalamaan khudhai dhe hi(n)dhoo har paramesur bhaanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Muslims are men of Allah and the Hindus love Hari (Visnu), the supreme god. files.shabads/81/40882.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40882,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":39,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":10,"first_verse_id":207101,"last_verse_id":207110,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":207101,"page_no":39,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"੧੨ : ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ","translit_en":"12 : satiguroo nivaas satisa(n)g vich","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The abode of true Guru is the holy congregation ,  "}}},{"verse_id":207102,"page_no":39,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ।","translit_en":"paarabraham pooran braham satigur saadhasa(n)gat vich vasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The true Guru is the transcendent perfect Brahm and resides in the holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":207103,"page_no":39,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਸਹਜ ਵਿਗਸੈ।","translit_en":"sabadh surat aaraadheeaai bhai bhagat bhai sahaj vigasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By absorbing the consciousness in the Word He is adored, and cherishing love, devotion and His awe He spontaneously blooms in the heart."}}},{"verse_id":207104,"page_no":39,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਸੋਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭੋਗੁ ਵਿਣਸੈ।","translit_en":"naa oh marai na sog hoi dhe(n)dhaa rahai na bhog vinasai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He never dies nor becomes sorrowful. "}}},{"verse_id":207151,"page_no":39,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"nira(n)kaar aakaar kar satigur guraa(n) guroo
